whatItIs: dwave-cloud-client is an open-source project in the annealing and ising category. It is maintained by dwavesystems and primarily looks like a Python codebase. A minimal implementation of the REST interface used to communicate with D-Wave Solver API (SAPI) servers.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches annealing and ising workflows in practice.
